title: Secure env variables by adding .claudeignore
body:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c72ba52c-9201-4634-bcea-3ada2b8ad0ad)

Should add .claudeignore to prevent env content being read or overwrite. For your safty and mine.
author: grandwaterman

top_comments.author: alialfa
top_comments.body: i added this but it still sees my env, bug ?

top_comments.author: rjnichols
top_comments.body:
Also seeing this issue, on Windows.
